problems: Seed-Capsule Gardener reads primarily as a sun hat, utility vest, trousers and boots. The capsules and wrist device do not outweigh the contemporary gardening silhouette.
Canopy Apprentice reads as a backwards baseball cap, padded vest, shorts and knee socks. Backpack attachments alone do not establish the age.

Habitat Memory Weaver reads as a hooded robed craftsperson holding a miniature loom. Its thin cyan threads disappear at stream scale, and the frame lacks a clearly visible connection to the hand or cuff.

Courier has the strongest everyday futuristic construction, but its central helmet crest and rectangular purple tabard also suggest a robot knight. Courier, Weaver and Envoy repeat similar purple frontal panels and blue-grey bodies.

Administrator has useful grandeur, a distinctive three-screen crown and a recognisable constellation badge. The narrow crown supports need clearer structural continuity, and the front-only office emblem loses prominence from above.

Envoy resembles a patched version of the local Courier more than an android delegation from elsewhere. The gold spear-like staff tip reinforces a medieval traveller reading; its small orbital badge cannot carry the foreign identity alone.

Pink shoulder strips and avatar-dependent wrist and shoe-edge details interrupt the intended materials. Several kits leave default sleeves visible. These inconsistencies are particularly apparent between the two wearers of each kit.

AGE (biggest problem): only the Courier, Administrator and Envoy look like the future. The Gardener (wide floppy sun hat, tan fishing-vest panels, navy trousers, green rubber boots) and the Canopy Apprentice (pancake cap, zip gilet, hiking backpack, knee pads) look like today's garden centre and hiking clothes in new colours. The Weaver (soft lavender hood, white face scarf, long plain slate robe, hand loom) looks like a medieval or desert pilgrim. The human kits have no future silhouette at all: no rigid collars, no shaped yokes, no capsule or visor headgear, no asymmetric cut.

FIT, base clothing showing through: the base shirt colour (pink on one wearer, cyan on the other) shows at the shoulder tops and neck on the Gardener and the Apprentice, and as a pink cuff at the Weaver's wrist. The jacket and pad parts do not cover the shoulder line, collar or forearm.

FIT, bare feet showing: 'shoes' is hidden, but the boot boxes do not reach the sole or the toe. A skin-coloured strip shows under the Gardener, Weaver (first wearer), Apprentice and Envoy. Each boot box ends at about y -0.80 and is too shallow in z, so the toes stick out.

Gardener: the two green 'cape' spheres behind the shoulders read as a big puff of hair behind the hat, not a seed pack. The seed capsule is a cyan ball with a little green cone and reads as a water balloon. The diagonal accent strap floats over the vest panels.

Weaver: the loom (armL) floats off to the side, below and away from the hand, so it does not read as held. The sage cape boxes behind the shoulders look like a block rucksack. From above, the silhouette is a hooded rectangle.

Apprentice: the cap is set too low. The flat-topped head shows above it, so it reads as a box head with a pancake on its forehead. The backpack seedling and lavender panel poke out above the right shoulder like clutter rather than a clear shape.

Distinctness: the Gardener and Apprentice share the same palette (sage-green jacket, tan, slate, navy boots) and the same human-hiker build, so at stream scale they blur together. The Weaver and Apprentice share the slate-blue body block.

Administrator: the clear, readable symbol of office is the three floating panels plus the node insignia, and that works. But the figure is ivory from shoulders to ankles: ivory legs, ivory mantle, ivory sleeves. It reads as a lab coat or white jumpsuit and breaks the bible's 'avoid all-white assets'. The bible asks for 'broad muted-lavender edging' but there are only small cuffs, and the dark teal underlayer is hidden. The mantle is a plain rectangle with no hem or collar shape.

Envoy (leader): the bible asks for a mid-teal layered travel tabard, but it is lavender, the same colour as the Courier's tabard, so the leader reads as a courier variant. The bible asks for a faceted meteorite token, but the kit has a long dark staff with a gold cone tip, which reads as a spear or medieval sceptre (avoid: weapons and medieval office symbols). The mismatched lavender and tan legs read as harlequin, not repaired. The tan head fin looks like a plank stuck on at an angle. The dark back cape merges into the torso, so nothing besides the staff makes the figure clear from far away.
fix:
Seed-Capsule Gardener: Replace the conventional brim-and-crown hat with a low, segmented grow-light canopy, visibly bracketed to a rear collar. Replace the tan vest halves with an asymmetric sealed cultivation bib. Raise the two seed capsules enough to read beside the head from above, retaining the broad sage silhouette. Hide default sleeves and fully enclose the original footwear. Ceramic Wrap-Tabard Courier: Keep the white shell, dark joints and parcel. Replace the knight-like central crest with an offset horizontal sensor block; reshape the purple rectangle into stepped, overlapping ceramic wrap plates. Give the parcel one broad cyan top panel rather than relying on its narrow front stripe. Habitat Memory Weaver: Turn the hood into an open-sided asymmetric data cowl with a large contrasting inset. Break the robe-like mass into overlapping torso panels and separate leg-mounted panels, preserving a visible leg gap. Add a solid grip or short bracket from the cuff to the loom; replace the three hairline threads with one bold cyan membrane inside a thicker frame. Hide remaining default sleeves. Canopy Apprentice: Remove the baseball cap and shorts-and-socks construction. Use a close-fitting ceramic brow band and a full-length articulated work suit with distinct knee joints. Consolidate the backpack clutter into one large folded canopy fin with a visible hinge, keeping this silhouette narrow and asymmetric rather than broad like the Gardener. Hide default sleeves and cover shoe edges. Administrator of the Shared Constellation: Preserve the white mantle, dark centre and three-screen crown. Connect every screen with substantial visible struts to one rigid upper-back assembly, parenting the supports and screens consistently. Repeat an enlarged, simplified constellation mark on the upward-facing mantle or crown top. Check the rear mantle against both legs throughout walking. Far-Orbit Patched-Tabard Envoy: Establish a separate charcoal-and-amber material language, a nonhuman face display and exposed mechanical neck blocks. Add a compact angular orbital frame physically mounted behind the head, distinct from both the Courier crest and Administrator crown. Replace the gold spearhead with a broad forked communications terminal; enlarge and repeat the orbital insignia on an upper-facing shoulder plate. Keep the patched asymmetry, but make it repaired machine casing rather than mismatched cloth. For every kit, verify both body variants at the actual stream camera and during walking, with no hovering accessories, exposed default garments or panels bridging moving limbs. / GENERAL (all human kits): 1) Add a shoulder yoke: a hips box about 0.50 wide, 0.10 tall, 0.32 deep at y≈0.58, coloured as the jacket. Add a standing collar: a hips cylinder about 0.36 diameter, 0.14 tall at y≈0.64. Together they close the pink/cyan base-shirt gap. Add full forearm sleeves wherever a pad covers only the upper arm. 2) Boots: on every kit that hides shoes, set the boot box to y -0.72, height 0.22, z +0.05, depth 0.32, so it covers the sole and toes. 3) Give each human one future-only shape, so the clothes stop being today's clothes recoloured: rigid collars, asymmetric diagonal closures, capsule or visor headgear, sculpted yokes. Tiny glow is allowed only on held tech.

SEED-CAPSULE GARDENER: replace the floppy sun hat with a rigid shallow shade-shell. Use a thin ivory (#f1e9e5) disc about 0.50 diameter, tilted 0.15 forward, over a blue-grey (#8191a5) band around the head, so it reads as engineered, not a straw hat. Replace the two tan vest panels with one asymmetric wrap jacket front: a tan box running diagonally from the left shoulder to the right hip (rotation z ≈ 0.35), with a dark seam strip along its edge. Delete the green back spheres, which read as hair. Put a compact ivory cylinder seed-pod pack on the back (cape bone), about 0.30 × 0.36, with a #91b493 band. Make the capsule an ivory egg (sphere 0.18 × 0.24) held right at the hand (armL y≈-0.47, z≈0.10), with a small #66f2df glow window.

CERAMIC COURIER: keep it, it is the strongest kit. Move the parcel up so the handle sits at the hand (armR y -0.46) and the box hangs just below it. To separate it from the leader, keep the Courier's tabard lavender (the leader goes teal). For a top-down read, add a small ivory back-carrier frame or a short dorsal fin on the cape bone.

HABITAT MEMORY WEAVER: replace the soft hood and face scarf with a rigid rounded cowl. Use a #8c80b4 shell sphere or box about 0.40 wide over the head's back and top, plus a high ivory (#d9d1e6) collar ring at the chin, so the face stays open. Turn the plain slate robe into a split long tabard: front and back panels on the hips bone with a diagonal hem in two tones (slate #64758d plus a lavender edge strip), and keep separate leg pieces under it. Pull the loom in close: armL position y -0.50, z ≈ 0.12, centred on the hand, about 0.26 wide. Shrink the sage back blocks to slim shoulder pads.

CANOPY APPRENTICE: replace the sunk cap with a head piece that covers the whole crown. Option one is a rounded helmet shell (head sphere about 0.38 × 0.22 × 0.36 at y≈0.36) with a visor lip. Option two is a headband with a mono-lens over one eye. The head top must not show above it. Make the backpack a terrarium dome that reads above the shoulders: a pale #d9d1e6 dome sphere on the cape bone with a sage sprout cone inside or on top, symmetric, and drop the scattered lavender and green slabs. Change the body colour so it no longer matches the Gardener: a lavender (#8c80b4) or blue-grey (#8191a5) one-piece suit with a sage diagonal panel, and dark boots.

ADMINISTRATOR (head): keep the three-panel crest and the insignia. Change the legs to the dark underlayer (#36495e) so the ivory reads as a mantle, not a jumpsuit. Add broad lavender (#8c80b4) edging: two vertical strips about 0.06 wide down the mantle's front opening, plus a hem band. Lengthen the mantle front panels on the hips bone down to about knee height, with a slight outward flare. Add a raised stand collar, a dark cylinder about 0.40 diameter, behind the jaw. Move the cyan bar (#55abc7) on the back of the cape so some of it shows past the shoulders from the front, or add lavender shoulder epaulettes, for more shoulder width from above.

FAR-ORBIT ENVOY (leader): recolour the tabard to the bible's mid-teal (#527c70), layered over slate, with a lavender inner layer showing at the hem, so it no longer matches the Courier. Replace the spear staff with the faceted meteorite token: two cones base-to-base (an octahedron), about 0.22, coloured #36495e with a #efbd66 facet, held at the right hand. For reading from far away, add a tall back-mounted beacon mast on the cape bone: a thin rod about 0.9 tall with a #66f2df glow ring at the top. Alternatively, lengthen the travel cloak to the shins in teal with a ragged two-step hem. Make both legs dark (#36495e), and put the repair story into one tan knee patch instead of a whole tan leg. Replace the angled tan plank on the head with a short slim antenna rod plus a small dish. Keep the red repair patch on the shoulder and the blue orbital ring emblem, because both read well.
